about_the_game:
📝 Diagnosis: No Answer is a single-player psychological puzzle game set in a surreal, minimalist 3D world of darkness, white walls and unsettling light.

You play as V, a patient strapped to a cold medical bed, slowly uncovering a haunting truth. Four scientists communicate with you through fragmented voices and texts, challenging your mind and your sanity.

Through exploration and intuition, you must solve deeply challenging puzzles that go beyond logic — each step revealing more of a philosophical story that questions the nature of reality, fear, and desperation.

This is not just a set of riddles, but an inner journey lasting up to 10 hours, where the meaning you find depends on how you understand it. There is a beginning, a middle and an end — yet even when you reach the conclusion, you may realize the real question was never fully answered.

With a minimalist third-person style, dramatic soundtrack and surreal atmosphere, Diagnosis: No Answer offers a unique psychological experience that few will complete.

⭐ Key Features

  • ~10 hours of intense, story-driven gameplay

  • Extremely challenging puzzles based on intuition rather than logic

  • Surreal and minimalist 3D environments seen from third person

  • Mysterious philosophical narrative with a hidden meaning

  • Voices and texts from four scientists revealing fragmented truths

  • Dramatic soundtrack enhancing the unsettling atmosphere

  • Built with Unreal Engine 5 for immersive visual quality

  • Fully in English, Windows only (≈2 GB)

name: Diagnosis: No Answer

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 или AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 4GB or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: For stable operation, SSD is recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 6GB (GV-N2060D6-6GD) or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: For stable operation, SSD is recommended

short_description: A psychological puzzle where reality breaks down and madness is the only compass. In this dark world, you are chained to your bed, but the only way out is to go deep into your own mind. There are no answers. There is only you.
